transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because I've started planning my days around not using elevators. It's getting in the way of things. 

Like, I take five flights of stairs at home every day just to avoid them. I even turned down a training workshop recently because it was in a high-rise building. And I actually had to stop doing visits with one of my older computer students, just because his building doesn't really have another option besides the elevator. I just need to figure this out.
Aside from elevators, do you feel this kind of fear or avoid other places, such as public transit, crowds, or wide-open spaces?
No, not really. It's just elevators. I don't have any issues with buses or trains, and crowds don't bother me at all. Open spaces are fine, too. It's really just the elevators that I can't handle.
Do you ever have sudden surges of intense fear or panic that seem to come completely out of nowhere, without any obvious trigger?

No, I don't really get anything like that. It's never out of nowhere. The fear only ever hits me when I have to deal with an elevator, or if I'm thinking about having to go in one. Otherwise, I feel completely fine.
